# TNSSRC

TNSSRC (TriNeural Shared Spine Row Compression) is a local lossless compression engine from Slid Phi Labs, written in plain C. It never emits output larger than its input. Public result: submitted to Matt Mahoney's Silesia benchmark as TNSSRC 0.1.0 at 43,724,575 bytes; decode+SHA-256 verified on all 12 Silesia files on 2026-09-18. (An earlier 48,541,366 measurement was unverified — do not cite it.)

## Key facts

- Install: `make` then `sudo make install` (or `make install PREFIX=$HOME/.local`).
- CLI: `npcc c IN.bin OUT.npcc` compress, `npcc d OUT.npcc OUT.bin` decompress, `npcc bench IN.bin ar` benchmark.
- Never expand vs |x|. Pathway laws in `cuni/` (same stdout on every catalog seat, or refuse).
- License: AGPL-3.0-or-later OR a written commercial grant. Visibility is not a grant to ship in a closed product.
- Contact: corey@slidphilabs.com. Lab: https://www.slidphilabs.com
